info.title: Snaglist implemented platform API
info.description: Implemented platform candidate, not production readiness or a complete unified platform. Adds nonce-bound Google sign-in exchanges for web and iOS, secure browser sessions and explicit recent-account linking. Existing company administration, fixed Contractor links, PIN/private evidence and manager acceptance retain their recorded evidence. Full native sync, provider UI acceptance, company branding/seats/billing, durable jobs, private R2/Linux staging and full design/integration gates remain incomplete. Adds actor-bound immutable project discovery and normalised internal comments in register snapshots/deltas; full native graph remains incomplete. Adds staging-gated legacy import preparation/publication (projection, processing, acknowledged atomic commit) and authenticated readback of published import records, drawings and verified bytes; imported legacy workflow states are qualified (legacy_unverified) and never enter the review queue.

Server configuration uses IMPORT_PREVIEW_API_ORIGIN, never PORTAL_ORIGIN, BASE_URL or request Host. Existing backend local maps explicitly to native development. legacyReferenceCount.description: Count of original project, snag and deletion-receipt reference values retained by the source. Their text is not sent or reserved.

sourceFindingCount.description: Sum of source export finding counts, including findings omitted from its bounded detail list. No finding text is sent.

relationshipFindingCount.description: Sum of archive relationship finding counts. This may concern the wider retained archive; it does not send other project records.

missingMediaReferenceCount.description: Missing source-media references, counted by role/reference rather than deduplicated file paths.

unsafeMediaReferenceCount.description: Unsafe source-media references, counted without sending the path text or handle.

Unknown fields, negative/out-of-range or contradictory counts are rejected; counts never establish byte verification, authorship or graph completeness.

LegacyImportPreviewCommand.description: Strict selected-project identity manifest, maximum 2 MiB encoded JSON. Extra fields are rejected at every nested request object. Do not send the complete native plan/export, credentials, Contractor link tokens/PINs, contact/comment text, local paths, media URLs/object keys, consent flags or executable pending requests. Actor and workspace selection must be explicit; this payload is not ownership consent.

Folders, tags and local status history currently have no checked canonical identity namespace; their empty namespacesChecked is not a clean graph result. Photo/drawing checks cover only listed current/legacy ID namespaces.

LegacyImportPreviewCollision.description: Returns only a caller-supplied ID and generic outcome. Same-workspace existing projects/records require reconciliation. Foreign or unscoped IDs/tombstones are unavailable without revealing their owner, workspace, names, metadata, paths or tokens. Does not reserve, adopt, merge or remap any record.

LegacyImportPreviewResponse.description: Immutable actor-bound diagnostic receipt, never a bearer capability, import approval or proof of historic ownership. The sole durable write is its mutation_receipts row. Checks re-run current authority/collisions before replay; expiry is 30 minutes after server creation. Source bytes, full graph, consent and import commit remain blockers even for a simple project. Entitlement and full native reconstruction are not established. requestHash covers typed request and route; previewFingerprint covers observed authority/collision/capability facts. Neither is the opaque export hash.
